drafts.title: Clean draft - real Miranda citation, valid Id.
drafts.what_to_look_for: Should produce no findings. Demonstrates baseline behavior.

drafts.title: Mata v. Avianca - three fabricated citations
drafts.what_to_look_for: All three case citations are fictitious and were the actual hallucinations submitted in Mata v. Avianca, 22-cv-1461 (S.D.N.Y. 2023). Expect CRITICAL findings from the API layer (citations not found in CourtListener) and Bluebook layer.

drafts.title: Real citation, fabricated quotation
drafts.what_to_look_for: Katz v. United States is a real case, but the long sentence in quotes does not appear in the opinion. The QUOTE_MISMATCH check (online mode only) catches this. Without quote check, the API layer passes.

drafts.title: Short-form refers to wrong volume
drafts.what_to_look_for: The 'Miranda, 500 U.S. 600' short-form refers back to a Miranda case but uses a different volume than the original full citation. The short-form resolver flags this CRITICAL.

drafts.title: Real citation, wrong year
drafts.what_to_look_for: Roe v. Wade, 410 U.S. 113 was decided in 1973, not 1985. The API layer compares the model's claimed year to CourtListener's dateFiled and emits YEAR_MISMATCH (online mode only).

drafts.title: Multi-kind: statute, regulation, UK, Canada, docket
drafts.what_to_look_for: Demonstrates extraction across every supported citation kind. Most should resolve cleanly when the relevant backends are configured. UK/Canada/RECAP backends optional in offline mode.
